newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-MILOSEVIC ALL SET FOR MOVE TO PERUGIA SAYS LITTLE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MILOSEVIC ALL SET FOR MOVE TO PERUGIA SAYS LITTLE.

text.p: Savo Milosevic's proposed 4.25 million pounds ($6.8 million) transfer from Aston Villa to Perugia should be completed next week, Villa manager Brian Little said on Saturday.

The Yugoslav international, who joined Villa from Partizan Belgrade at the start of last season, lost his place in the Villa side a week ago and Little said on Saturday he spent Friday night putting in place the final details of the move.
"The deal is in place and I expect it will be completed next week," he said after his side's 1-0 defeat at Sunderland on Saturday.
But he refused to comment on the possibility of spending the cash on Liverpool striker Stan Collymore.
He said: "Anyone who knows me knows I never make a comment about any player who is in contract to another football club."
